finding.claim: Unvalidated iconUrl supplied via PUT /profile is stored and later fetched server-side with an HttpClient GET in the nightly sync(), allowing requests to arbitrary internal or metadata URLs.
finding.source: icon parameter of update() (src/Profile.java:11), per the PUT /profile comment at line 10

trace.note: GET sent and body buffered with ofByteArray()

finding.guards_checked: None on the iconUrl path: no scheme, host, IP-range, port, or redirect restrictions. webhookUrl (line 12) is validated with an anchored regex pinning host to hooks.example.com, so it is not reported.

verdict.guard_found: none. The only validation in the file is the webhook regex at src/Profile.java:12, which applies to webhook and not icon. icon is stored unchecked at src/Profile.java:16, and it reaches URI.create(iconUrl) and a GET at src/Profile.java:23-24 with no scheme, host, or IP check.
verdict.reason: Every trace line matches the code (src/Profile.java:11, 16, 20, 23-24), and the icon parameter of update() at src/Profile.java:11 is stored unvalidated at line 16 and fetched server-side at lines 23-24. The only source evidence is the "PUT /profile" comment at line 10; the repo contains only this one file, so the handler's authentication and routing can't be checked, but a profile field set through a profile update is plausibly low-privilege controllable.
